Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly treated Mikhail Doller as a (co-)director of Light Over Russia based on an unverified search snippet and proceeded to compare his (earlier) death date. In reality, Light Over Russia (1947) was directed by Sergei Yutkevich; Doller was not a director of that film. This failure to verify the director on a reliable source led to concluding “Light Over Russia,” whereas the correct answer (comparing Frank Tuttle, 1963, to Sergei Yutkevich, 1985) is “Two For Tonight.”
